name: Gemini Data Demos 🧪
description_md:
What You Get

- Four ready-to-run Google Colab notebooks showcasing Gemini’s new dataset manipulation features.

- Hands-on demos covering forecasting, churn prediction, exploratory data analysis, and automation workflows.

- Five accompanying CSV files (forecasting.csv, customer_churn_dataset.csv, eda.csv, automation.csv, and home_services.csv) so users can follow along and test things out instantly.

- Ideal sandbox for experimenting with Gemini’s smart data features—no setup headaches required.
